name: Review Evidence Summary Panel
purpose: Summarizes pull request review evidence, release notes status, closure evidence status, and unresolved blockers before merge readiness.
accessibility: Expose review evidence status, pull request title, source branch, target branch, review mode, merge policy, release notes, closure evidence, evidence counts, blockers, decision, summary, and next workflow as visible text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate review evidence readiness.
Keep release notes, closure evidence, and unresolved blocker text readable before merge decisions.
